interaction: Drag the sun along its arc (or use the 6am–7pm slider or 'play the day'): the sky gradient, roof panels, lit windows, a battery gauge and a live generation area chart with a 'you are here' marker all follow; the estimator turns a quarterly bill, roof direction and daytime usage into a suggested system size and illustrative generation and savings ranges with every assumption listed.
notes: Generation, battery and savings figures come from a simple illustrative model (clear-sky curve, fixed tariffs), not site data; no rebates or schemes are modelled.
